planning_notes: Board is fixed to arduino:avr:uno and pins are fixed to A0 (analog input), D9 (PWM output), and D13 (digital output) as provided.
No explicit serial reporting or serial receive requirements were provided; therefore no serial_channels entries are requested.
Control period is set to 10 ms as a scheduling granularity; the mapping from A0 to PWM on D9 (including inversion: stronger light -> lower LED PWM) belongs in the SysML model, not in device requests.
No startup thresholds, calibration scale/offset, or sensor sampling period were specified; device requests rely on legal catalog defaults for sampling/electrical scaling.
